transcript.content: Hi, welcome in—thanks for coming today. Can you start by telling me what brought you in to see me?

I guess... mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I've stopped doing pretty much everything. I stopped hiking, coaching, playing my guitar... I don't even call people back. Some days I just sit in my small rental for hours. I know there are things I need to do, but I just... I can't make myself start.
How long have you been feeling this way—when did you first notice you stopped wanting to do these things?

It's been... well, things have really just been unraveling since I moved into this smaller rental. That was right after my divorce, so... it's been about a year and two months ago. That's when I first noticed it.
Over this past year and two months, has your low mood and loss of interest been present pretty much every day without a break, or have there been stretches where you felt more like your normal self?
I'm not really sure. It's hard to say if there were breaks... it all just kind of runs together since I moved. I haven't really noticed any times where I felt like my old self.
Have you ever had a period—lasting several days or more—where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual, even if it was before this current low period started?

No, I don't think so. I mean... before all this started, I had regular energy, just enough to do my job and my normal stuff. But I've never felt unusually high or anything like that. And I've always needed a normal amount of sleep.
Over this past year, have you noticed any changes in your sleep or appetite—like sleeping much more or less than usual, or a significant change in your appetite or weight?

No, not really. I mean... my appetite is about the same. I just eat what I normally do, so my weight hasn't really changed as far as I can tell. And with sleep... I guess I'm sleeping about the same amount I always have. Nothing really stands out there.
During this past year, have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt about things, even minor things?
No, I wouldn't say that. I don't really feel guilty about anything... and I don't feel worthless, exactly. Just... empty, I guess. But no excessive guilt or anything like that.
Over this past year, have you noticed a persistent lack of energy or feeling tired most days, even when you haven't been especially active?

No, I wouldn't say I'm tired. My energy is actually fine. I mean... I might not be doing a whole lot right now, but it's not because I'm physically exhausted. I just have normal energy, I guess. I don't feel fatigued or anything like that.
Over this past year, have you noticed trouble concentrating, focusing on tasks, or making everyday decisions?
No, my concentration is fine. I can focus on things if I need to. I don't really have any trouble making decisions, either. Everything just feels... normal in that regard, I suppose.
